note: THE CONTENT DOCUMENT — the course. This is the slot the course goes in: one document, loaded through src/lib/contentLoader.js and checked by src/lib/contentSchema.js, so adding the course is a data change here rather than a code change anywhere. The general-knowledge set that used to sit here came out for the beta (`git log -- src/content/test-content.json` is where it lives if it is ever wanted back); from 2026-09-21 it held the owner's own material; on 2026-10-03 all three chapters came out at his word ("delete all quizzes and sets and all traces of them") and the replacement batches are on their way, so every module is waiting on its first chapter again and every empty line says so. The `content.test` switch in src/lib/flags.js is on for everyone so every visitor loads it. Module NAMES are here and in src/data.js, and the two must agree: data.js is what the Flight Deck draws before this document arrives. Module CODES (M1–M4) never change — progress and saves are keyed to them.
contentModel: modules[] -> chapters[] -> lessons[] and one quiz per chapter. A chapter may also carry cards[] — its study-card set, same shape as a quiz question; without it the card set is the quiz's questions. A module may carry downloads[] — {id, title, file, pages}, a file under public/ offered as a plain download, never opened in the reader. notes, threads, replies, people and presence are the lesson surface's own rows. See contentSchema.js for the exact shape and the validator that enforces it.
